reconstruction_method: source-precedence ladder (executing source > persisted audit/table > executed notebook > frozen protocol/README > prose)

evidence: reports/audits/phase14_diagnostic_protocol_amendment.md §6 (A3 policy): 1162 GT-derived base crops + 2324 perturbed crops + 1542 background negatives = 5028 crops/epoch
reports/audits/phase14_diagnostic_protocol_amendment.md §3 Condition C: the same refiner is evaluated on frozen Stage-4D PREDICTED proposals
HISTORICAL_TRAIN_INFERENCE_PROPOSAL_DIST.statement: The historical Phase-14 regional refiner was TRAINED on GT-derived base crops, GT-perturbed crops and random background negatives, but EVALUATED on Stage-4D predicted proposals. The training and inference proposal distributions therefore did not match.
HISTORICAL_TRAIN_INFERENCE_PROPOSAL_DIST.consequence: The Phase-14 Step-3 failure (D_p 0.383905 vs D_g 0.652776, driven by 5.43 FP components/image vs 0.37 baseline) is at least partly attributable to this distribution gap and is NOT a clean measurement of predicted-proposal regional refinement.
HISTORICAL_TRAIN_INFERENCE_PROPOSAL_DIST.clean_v3_action: Any clean-v3 regional integration must draw training crops from predicted proposals (with an explicit negative-sampling policy) or explicitly declare and measure the gap.

LATENT_INFERENCE_HEATMAP_RESOLUTION_OMIS.evidence: src/inference/learned_roi.py predict_localizer calls create_model("kub_localizer", in_channels=1, out_channels=1, base_channels=16) with no heatmap_resolution argument
LATENT_INFERENCE_HEATMAP_RESOLUTION_OMIS.statement: The Stage-4D checkpoint was trained with a 128x128 output heatmap (AvgPool2d(4,4)). The inference helper would construct the 512-output variant. Because the logit downsample is parameter-free and the head is a 1x1 convolution, the state dict still loads, so the mismatch is silent and the helper would return a 512-space heatmap.
LATENT_INFERENCE_HEATMAP_RESOLUTION_OMIS.impact: Proposal geometry (factor = 512 // heatmap_resolution) would be wrong for the Stage-4D checkpoint. The Phase-13B notebooks used the dataset/evaluator path, so the historical frozen numbers are not affected.
LATENT_INFERENCE_HEATMAP_RESOLUTION_OMIS.clean_v3_action: Pass heatmap_resolution explicitly (or freeze an output-resolution contract) and add a regression test.

STAGE4D_DESIGN_AUDIT_LABEL_AMBIGUITY.evidence: reports/audits/phase13b_stage4d_design_audit.json keys the Stage-4C numbers under "clean_v3_results" while the localizer VAL denominator was 156 (v2)
STAGE4D_DESIGN_AUDIT_LABEL_AMBIGUITY.statement: The label most plausibly refers to the clean-v3 ARCHITECTURE (KUBLocalizer), not the clean-v3 MANIFEST.
STAGE4D_DESIGN_AUDIT_LABEL_AMBIGUITY.clean_v3_action: Supervisor confirmation before any reuse of the Stage-4C numbers.
